title: Brand Interaction Effect: population weight, uncertainty and cohort quality
summary: Brand Interaction Effect v0.6 turns privacy-minimised interaction evidence into scoped association evidence. It keeps sample/time sufficiency, effect magnitude, confidence and cohort-quality gates independent and carries denominator construction plus uncertainty into the reasoning packet.
invariants: The denominator travels with the numerator.
Classifier/taxonomy, time scope and outcome lag are frozen into the evidence frame.
Confidence is exposed separately from count sufficiency and point effect size.
Cohort construction deduplicates units before counts become evidence.
Source selection, exclusion, unresolved eligibility and missingness remain visible.
CONVENIENCE or a low selected percentage is not automatically labelled biased.
Association intervals never self-promote to causality.

provenance.claim: Cohort provenance pipeline and non-moralizing cohort quality gate.
Evidence invariants for denominator, confidence, dedup, missingness and causality.
